messages:
Sam H: starting a small docs PR for the private/on-prem install troubleshooting section. adding a short checklist for validating mirrored package repos + a KMS connectivity verification flow. putting up a draft in ~30m for quick eyes.
Priya M: great. include both apt and yum examples and a terse note for zypper users. also add the distro metadata file to check (e.g., Release/repodata).
Sam H: will do apt/yum + a generic curl against the repo URL to ensure index reachable. also drafting a snippet to show verifying GPG signature of the repo archive.
Jonas L: for KMS: show a small loop that attempts the TLS handshake (openssl s_client) and a curl to the KMS health endpoint, with exponential backoff suggestion.
Sam H: snippet idea: ```bash
# repo health (apt)
curl -fsS --max-time 5 https://mirror.local/repo/dists/stable/Release || echo "repo index unreachable"
# verify checksum and sig
sha256sum -c /tmp/release.sha256 || echo "bad checksum"
if ! gpg --verify /tmp/release.tar.gz.sig /tmp/release.tar.gz; then echo "signature mismatch"; fi
```
Priya M: nice. for yum show `repoquery --repoid=local` as an optional check.
Sam H: adding a yum line and also a short command to check that the repo's cert matches the installer CA bundle (openssl x509 -noout -fingerprint).
Jonas L: on KMS fallback text: call out the exact path for local keystore and a one-line to export it for rotation. something like: `/var/lib/redwood/keys/*` and `redwood-ctl keys export --dest /tmp/keys.tar.enc`. keep it non-prescriptive about rotation schedule.
Sam H: included a short paragraph: "Installer prefers remote KMS. If unreachable, it will create local encrypted keystores in /var/lib/redwood/keys. Arrange rotation and backup in your infra runbook; use redwood-ctl to export/import as needed."
infra-bot: infra-checker: PR build succeeded; flagged one dead link in the draft to docs/install/releases -> should be docs/releases/overview.
docs-ci: link-checker: also flagged that example GPG key ID is literal; security wants a placeholder instead of a real-looking key.
Priya M: please replace the key with <REPO_GPG_KEY_ID> and add a note: "do not paste secret keys into docs".
Sam H: done; updated the PR and squashed. leaving a short troubleshooting bullet: "If repo index reachable but installer still fails, check proxy env vars (HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY) for the installer user."
Jonas L: LGTM from infra side. small nit: change 'exponential backoff' to 'retry with increasing delay' for readability.
Sam H: changed wording, rebased, will merge after one more review. thanks all :tada:
